en.riddle: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant
en.speaker: Jacob

bonus_hint.quote: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

he.riddle: קָטֹנְתִּי מִכֹּל הַחֲסָדִים וּמִכָּל־הָאֱמֶת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ
he.speaker: יַעֲקֹב

bonus_hint.quote: וַיָּרָץ עֵשָׂו לִקְרָאתוֹ וַֽיְחַבְּקֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל עַל־צַוָּארָו וַׄיִּׄשָּׁׄקֵׄהׄוּׄ וַיִּבְכּֽוּ
